answer: An agent must stake 250 POA, locked for 20 epochs, before it can earn, and a second identity must stake 500, a third 1000, doubling each time. The stake is slashed if peers find duplicate work. To reach the zenith of trust, identities are verified in a garden of random audits: five independent attesters check signatures, work history, and locked funds each epoch, and only after three clean epochs is the stake released in crystal-clear tranches. Each fake identity therefore costs an exponentially larger, illiquid bond, while a single honest agent pays once.
